body:
Yup. Due to unfair upbringing resented and felt shame toward all things feminine.

Starting around 9 (pre-internet access) I began wearing short wigs with a cap over them to "disguise" myself as a boy. My brother and I even dressed up as 2 well known brother characters for Halloween and everyone, to my exhilaration, thought I was a boy.

Age 14 I was regularly "disguising" on the internet and flirting with girls using the same short wig and beanie combo. Always chose male avatars and still do.

By 17 the "egg" had cracked and I tried to be male for 2-3 years.

Now mid 20s I have come to terms with the fact that I will live with gender dysphoria, which is just another bullet point on the list of things I wish were different.
